name: Candi
_about: A CENTRAL JAVANESE TEMPLE (candi), 8th-10th century, Prambanan's type: three worlds stacked. The BASE (kaki) a redented square `w` across and `bh` high, moulded; a GALLERY on it (`gallery` yes|no) inside a balustrade `bah` high and `bt` thick, ratnas `rb` high on its top, a gate (`gH` clear) where each stair arrives; STAIRS `sw` wide and steep (`stairs` four|two|one|none: one on the front, +z, two the front and +x), a makara either side of each foot. The BODY (tubuh) a square `bw` across and `bH` high under a slab `cs` thick: the cella's walls `wt` thick with its door (`dw` x `dh`) at the back of the front porch (`cella` open), or a solid with false doors (`cella` solid); a PORCH `pw` x `pd`, `pH` high, on every stair's side, each under a stepped roof and a ratna. The ROOF (atap): `tiers` three|four|five, the first `tw` across and `t1` high, each next one `k` of the last, every ledge ringed with ratnas (`ratnas` corners|three|five|seven a side, `rr` high on the first), the crowning ratna `ch` high on top. `ratna`/`crownform` vajra|bell|spike pick the ratnas' form, `mould` yes|no the mouldings (no: plain blocks, the cheap one for a temple seen by the hundred). y 0 on the ground. Written by tools/archgen/javanese.py; its candi() works the sizes out from a temple's width and height, finish_rules() its reliefs.
